appDescription.message: ADHDGoFly-Plugin is an intelligent reading assistant browser extension designed to enhance text comprehension and reading experience. Smart text highlighting for better focus and comprehension with multi-language support (English, Spanish, French, Japanese, Russian, Chinese). Features advanced morphological analysis, customizable highlighting patterns, ADHD-friendly design, and privacy-focused local processing. Perfect for students, professionals, language learners, and individuals with ADHD.
